The transparency obligations for providers and deployers of certain AI systems under the EU AI Act are established in Article 50, which addresses various scenarios including AI systems that interact directly with natural persons, generate synthetic content, and more. Providers of systems generating synthetic audio, image, video, or text content must ensure that outputs are marked in a machine-readable format and detectable as artificially generated or manipulated. These obligations require that technical solutions are effective, interoperable, robust, and reliable, considering the specificities and limitations of various types of content.

These transparency obligations take effect on August 2, 2026.
